overview: The period is dominated by infrastructure: LLM pipelines extract dark-matter model cards and galaxy discussions from arXiv; the FAIR Universe weak-lensing uncertainty challenge releases a benchmark; JAX Gaussian-process inference and SWXAI target scalable noise modeling and explainability. Gravitational-wave work covers LISA glitch classification, EMRI inference, and Einstein Telescope early warning.
themes: LLM literature mining and agent tools
